home.title: A room, flatmates, and everything that comes after

consent.title: Before you start
consent.lead: Coloc needs your agreement to keep your account and handle your requests. The AI models run on the platform's server; your texts are not sent to an outside service.
consent.terms: I accept the terms of use
consent.media: I agree that my photos are processed (location data removed, faces and text blurred). Needed only to post a listing with photos.
consent.required: These three boxes are needed to use Coloc.

legal.draft: Draft. This text describes how the platform works; no lawyer has reviewed it.
terms: Coloc puts people looking for a room, for flatmates or for a place to share in touch, and helps flatmates organise themselves.
Coloc does not check who owns a home. A badge says exactly what was checked, and nothing more.
Coloc handles no payments. Costs and rents entered are notes between flatmates.
Legal information and generated documents are general information, not legal advice.
Listings that exclude someone for their gender, religion, origin or another protected trait are not allowed.
privacy: Account: e-mail address, chosen name, password (stored hashed).
Profile: the budget, reference place, dates and lifestyle you give. They are used for search and to compare flatmates.
Photos: location data is removed; faces and readable text are blurred before any analysis.
Assistant: your messages are analysed by models that run on the platform's server. A masked copy (phone numbers, e-mails and names replaced) is kept for 30 days to follow the conversation.
You can withdraw your agreement at any time; the conversation with the assistant is then deleted.
